description: The bar chart illustrates performance gain (in percent) for three LVLMs under two supervision settings, comparing “Strong Supervision” versus “Weak Supervision.” The horizontal axis contains the model categories labeled (left to right) “GPT-4o,” “Claude-3.5-Sonnet,” and “Qwen2-72B-VL,” and the vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 units. For each model, there are two adjacent bars: a hatched blue bar for Strong Supervision and a solid blue bar for Weak Supervision. For GPT-4o, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 24–25%, while the Weak Supervision bar is around 5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the Strong Supervision bar is about 9–10% and the Weak Supervision bar is about 3–4%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the Strong Supervision bar is approximately 15% and the Weak Supervision bar is around 5%. The bars are grouped by model (two bars per group) and appear in the listed model order rather than being sorted by bar height, with no additional annotations or special emphasis beyond the hatch pattern distinguishing Strong Supervision.
